edits.current: Second surname. NOT mandatory here - a material contrast with the electronic payroll, where SegundoApellido is use=required and a single-surname employee forces a placeholder. The same employee can therefore be reported correctly in PILA and imperfectly in the XML.
edits.proposed: Second surname. NOT mandatory here - a material contrast with the electronic payroll, where SegundoApellido is use=required and a single-surname employee forces a substitute value. The same employee can therefore be reported correctly in PILA and imperfectly in the XML.

edits.current: THE FIFTH AND MOST-MISSED BASE: IBC otros parafiscales diferentes a CCF - the base for SENA, ICBF, ESAP and MEN. Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17 defines it differently from the pension, health and occupational-risk IBC: it includes paid rest days and it is UNCAPPED - the 25-SMMLV ceiling does not apply. Header campo T2R1-020 is the sum of campo 45 (IBC CCF), NOT of this field. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) campo 95. For an all-inclusive (integral) salary this base is 70% of the integral salary, like the IBC fields (CST art. 132; Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49). Source: the parafiscal base computed by the payroll engine under this rule (wage type 64991 'Parafiscals Base actual', uncapped, including paid vacation wage type 79401, is the base on which SENA 2%, wage type 25112, and ICBF 3%, wage type 25111, are computed). Campo 95 and campo 45 (T2R2-045) are two separate bases populated under their own AT2 v30 rules and may legitimately differ; the engine stores and reports them independently, never deriving one from the other.
